purpose: Bind the published 5.0.14 Library personal-view migration, per-player privacy and lifecycle expectations to the exact source and existing host cases, with a distinct final-package client/save/export acceptance oracle. No runtime execution or new positive native verdict.

static_review.method: Exact fetched blob identities and 16 source-text checks; no Lua interpreter, Factorio, native windows, player saves or GitHub CI executed in this review.

observations.finding: A per-index storage.mir_library.players record is projected through local_view; typed Research query bytes remain distinct from model-normalized search.
observations.limit: Does not establish focus/caret/scroll behavior under actual GUI input.

observations.finding: on_configuration_changed copies legacy browser personal data only when no current private view exists; preserves an explicit bounded legacy snapshot with an authoritative original source, and fills report switches only when unset.
observations.limit: The preserved convenience snapshot may be truncated; it must not be called a full lossless replacement. Current preferences win on a repeated configuration event.

observations.finding: Removal clears the indexed private record, marks legacy player history retired, and GUI callbacks validate the owned tagged-root ancestry.
observations.limit: Static guards and host doubles are not an actual account-index-reuse client observation.

observations.finding: on_load reconnects translation working references only; joined and left callbacks have separate view/render/cleanup branches.
observations.limit: Does not establish remote client rejoin, real language completion or cold-load persistence.

observations.finding: Help report checkbox updates target the saved personal view after ownership checks; user-triggered file exports route through an indexed explicit file writer, not the tab renderer.
observations.limit: No actual file or privacy readback has been done for 5.0.14 in this review.

static_review.existing_host_result: Methods present in inspected test source. Their declarations are not an execution receipt from this review.

required_input_binding: Select exact published 5.0.14 edition package and matching Factorio engine; record archive hash, exact unchanged actor/fixture version, enabled mods, world/source save and startup values.
Use selected 0.3.13 input / 0.4.7 export observer bindings without combining incompatible same-name variants. Bind actual player indices, client languages, input transport and output paths.

Any historical migration claim must begin with an observed nonpristine predecessor saved personal view, including explicit original query, filters, report flags, selected item and geometry; never synthesize history from a default current client.

case_matrix.operation: same-force two-client opening, switching and input
case_matrix.expected: Two simultaneously distinct EN/DE client indices; their own queries, selected technology, hidden IDs, Settings query and report inclusion switches remain isolated; shared native force current research, queue and progress stay unchanged.
case_matrix.required_observations: Native GUI/input event and both indexed personal view readbacks; not screenshots alone.

case_matrix.expected: After disconnect/rejoin and saved-host restart, each existing account recovers its own view and valid translations, with no foreign preview or query swap.
case_matrix.required_observations: Two-client connection/session identities, before/after saved personal view snapshots and actual host restart. Source on_load alone cannot pass.

case_matrix.expected: Old personal choices are not imported into the replacement account after removal; original legacy preservation remains a distinct historical snapshot and cannot seed the new record.
case_matrix.required_observations: Actual pre-removal profile and preserved source, removed-event and new account/index identity, new default private view and two account readbacks.

case_matrix.operation: real full, compact and diagnostics export
case_matrix.expected: No file on mere open/tab render; explicit player-origin commands create the intended files with matching content and personal report inclusion scope, while server-origin output remains classified separately.
case_matrix.required_observations: Exact output filenames, bytes, decoded payloads, submitting player indices and no-export control; read native files rather than relying on a preview.

case_matrix.operation: migration save and two independent cold loads where applicable
case_matrix.expected: Genuine predecessor private view and native earned research, unfinished progress, queue and bonus stay preserved, followed by one ordinary completion and a saved successor whose two cold-load records agree.
case_matrix.required_observations: Original protected predecessor save and initial before-work observation; physical science/payment, completion/bonus, saved bytes, cold1/cold2 immutable copies and semantic comparators. Do not substitute an initialized current default or scripted credit.

exclusions: Do not classify prior 5.0.13 observer or earlier MIR4 screenshots as public 5.0.14 native input.
Do not infer same-index privacy from host doubles, a one-client screenshot or serial session.
Do not treat an old bounded convenience snapshot as deletion/replacement of the authoritative old state.
Do not treat an export preview, unchanged source hash or better diagnostics as successful file output.
Do not claim full native support if the approved two-client 7168MiB resource guard refuses admission.
Do not rerun accepted A612 source, unchanged Angel/agriculture cases or usurp Black Glass Foundation/server-export execution.

coordination_and_disposition.ownership: This review covers one new evidence file only. Black Glass retains all player source, integration, native execution and publication; current server-export and Foundation assignments untouched.
coordination_and_disposition.verdict: Unperformed 5.0.14 personal saved-view, real client input/lifecycle and export-file behavior remain blocking stable acceptance. No new gameplay defect is alleged from static text.
coordination_and_disposition.release_status: 5.0.14 remains published prerelease; do not mark stable.
coordination_and_disposition.follow_up: Adopt these precise expectations in an independently reviewed existing native/client packet when the sole execution owner admits it. Retain original negative receipts and zero-pass limits.
